description: Records an in-person sale of a card in the user's collection: a Deal Desk purchase (dealId), a cardId or a claimId, with the total sale price, quantity and any fees (venue show by default). Ask the user "Record <card> sold for $<price>?" and pass confirm true after they say yes. A card that sold online and isn't confirmed yet is refused. The card leaves the collection (its oldest cost lots are used) and the sale counts in today's Deal Desk numbers. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

cardId.description: Or the card's SlabLineage id in the user's collection.

confirm.description: True once the user said yes to recording this sale; never set it before that.

fees.description: Any fees paid on this sale in USD (default 0).

idempotencyKey.description: A unique key for this record (any short text you make up once); a retry with the same key never records twice.

salePrice.description: The total sale price in USD.

name: log_sale
title: Log an in-person sale
